name: Copenhagen, Denmark 🇩🇰
subtitle: Post-Noma — still the world's most exciting food city
items: Geranium (Rasmus Kofoed, #1 World's Best 2022, 3-star — the New Nordic pinnacle)
Alchemist (Rasmus Munk, Refshaleøen, 2-star — 50 courses, planetarium dome, a 6-hour experience, #5 World's Best)
Kadeau (Christianshavn, Nicolai Nørregaard, 2-star — everything from Bornholm island)
Barr (in Noma's old building, Thorsten Schmidt + René Redzepi — Nordic comfort food done beautifully)
Aamanns 1921 (Nørreport, Adam Aamann — elevated smørrebrød, beef tartare with brown butter, the best lunch in Copenhagen)
Kødbyens Fiskebar (Meatpacking District, Jamie Lee — sustainable seafood, cold-water species)
Bæst (Nørrebro, Christian Puglisi — wood-fired pizza + in-house charcuterie + cheese)
Hart Bageri (Nørrebro, Richard Hart, former Tartine + Noma — the best pastries in Copenhagen)
La Banchina (Refshaleøen, wine bar in a boathouse by the harbour)
Radio (Frederiksberg, Claus Meyer + team, organic, monthly-changing Nordic)
Torvehallerne Market (Nørreport — glass food hall, the tastiest pitstop in Copenhagen)
Goldfinch (Nyhavn alley — Copenhagen's New Asian Wave, Korean-Chinese-Japanese)
Juno the Bakery (Østerbro, Emil Glaser, cult cardamom rolls)
Wulff & Konstali (multiple, market + gourmet grocery — take the Aamanns open sandwich to go)
The Standard (Havnegade, Kofoed's casual restaurant + jazz club)
Lykke (natural wine bar, Vesterbro)
Popl (by Noma team, hamburger spot near old Noma building)
Nørrebro Bryghus (brewery + kitchen)
Bæst's neighbor coffee bar (Nørrebro, the lineup)
Gasoline Grill (Islands Brygge, the smash burger queue)
